verdict.rationale: First-party docs say a sandbox is an isolated cloud computer where the agent can 'run code, install software, manage files'. Arbitrary shell access comes through standard SSH clients and Cmd/REPL process contexts. Docker-in-Sandbox and a persistent writable root filesystem show that installed packages and system-level changes are supported and kept. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that arbitrary commands and package installs work as documented.
